canonical_work.author: Ramdayal Munda
canonical_work.scope: Mundari language; provider description states that the book contains stories and poetries from Mundari language

verified_manifestations.access_observation: metadata record discoverable; file identity advertised by provider

deduplication.canonicalization_rule: CIIL Sanchika metadata, Bharatavani item and advertised PDF are manifestations/records of one canonical work and must not be counted as independent corroborating sources.

rights_access_consent_cultural_uncertain.notes: Stories and poetry may contain literary, pedagogical, traditional, authored or adapted material. Do not classify individual passages as community-wide cultural facts without exact-text inspection, attribution/provenance and cultural-governance review.

required_before_promotion: obtain and hash authoritative provider PDF where access and terms permit
verify title page, edition/publication metadata and PDF-to-print pagination
inventory story/poem titles, authorship/adaptation/translation attribution and internal provenance
create exact page/section/text locators only for supported propositions
separate linguistic/literary evidence from cultural assertions
verify reuse/redistribution terms at file level
apply consent and cultural-governance restrictions where persons, performances, sacred/restricted knowledge or community-sensitive material are implicated

gap_policy: Any unavailable, restricted, unverified or culturally uncertain material remains an explicit gap and is not marked complete.
source_basis: Provider metadata verified 2026-09-23; no unsupported cultural proposition promoted.
